rationale: The non-modal side panel (ServiceGraphNodeSidePanel + ODrawer) is its own feature area, distinct from the catalog table behavior. service-catalog.spec.js covers pagination/sort/filter/pills and has exactly ONE side-panel smoke test ('Row click opens side panel') that only asserts visibility — none of the non-modal mechanics (overlay pointer-events-none, outside-click ignored, behind-page interactivity, close/reopen, Escape, RED/ops/tabs/metrics) are covered there. service-graph.spec.js is @enterprise-gated (topology endpoint is #[cfg(feature="enterprise")]) and does not run in the OSS CI. The run-context spec_path designates a dedicated new spec; the OSS-reachable entry is Services Catalog, so the new spec drives the shared panel through that path. Register the new file in ci_matrix.json under the Traces group run_files.
